queries: WITH qualifying AS (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN `U-PRO` = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN RA = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0), per_patient AS (SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) AS avg_diff FROM Laboratory l JOIN qualifying q ON q.ID = l.ID GROUP BY l.ID) SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_of_avg_pt, AVG(avg_diff) AS avg_of_avg_tat_diff FROM per_patient

assumptions.assumption: A patient qualifies if some of their lab records have U-PRO = '-' and some (possibly different) record has RA = '-'; the two results need not be on the same record/date.
Per-patient averages use all of the patient's lab records. Rows where TAT or TAT2 is NULL are ignored for the difference average, and patients with no non-null value are ignored in the final average.

alternatives.interpretation: A patient qualifies only if a single lab record has both U-PRO = '-' and RA = '-'; averages still use all of that patient's records.
